## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The sectional-analysis (*kē* 科) volume of [智祥](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E7%A5%A5) Zhìxiáng's three-part *Fǎhuá jīng shòushǒu* 法華經授手 commentarial complex (see [KR6d0087](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0087), [KR6d0089](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0089)). Compiled by Pínjí Zhìxiáng 頻吉智祥 (1637–1709) himself.

**Abstract**

The *Shòushǒu kē* provides the structural-outline navigational apparatus to Zhìxiáng's *Shòushǒu* main commentary, parallel to [KR6d0084](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0084) (the *Dàchéng kē*) on [大義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A4%A7%E7%BE%A9) Dàyì's *Dàchéng*. The three-part Zhìxiáng *Shòushǒu* complex (front matter, sectional analysis, main commentary) follows the standard Sòng-Yuán-Míng-Qīng editorial pattern of providing complete navigational apparatus for major commentarial productions.
